`jfk.wav` is the public John F. Kennedy speech sample distributed by whisper.cpp:
https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/blob/master/samples/jfk.wav

Downloaded from the project's official GitHub repository over verified HTTPS.
SHA-256: `59dfb9a4acb36fe2a2affc14bacbee2920ff435cb13cc314a08c13f66ba7860e`.
Used only to check real recognition of known speech, without mocked transcripts.

`bg-animal.jpg` is the rembg project example `examples/animal-1.jpg`:
https://github.com/danielgatis/rembg/blob/main/examples/animal-1.jpg

Downloaded via verified HTTPS. SHA-256: `4ddbd2f88e516892df62b73005a32965dde9a06d9b5565aad78f1b91ff53a6d7`.
Used to test real segmentation of a central animal, alpha and audio-preserving video composition.
